review_candidates.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Reporting directly to the MEP Engineering Manager , this role is responsible for design reviews, material approvals, and testing & commissioning (T&C) for Medium Voltage (MV 11kV–33kV) power distribution, shore power connection systems, auxiliary substations, and facility electrical building services. Missions/Main Duties Key Responsibilities Design Review & Engineering Compliance Submittal Verification: Perform rigorous technical reviews of engineering packages (Concept, Detailed, IFC, and As-B
eligibility_evidence: The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally.

Standards & Life Safety Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to HSR international standards (EN/IEC, AREMA), local power utility codes, and life-safety specifications for passenger facilities and enclosed depot halls (NFPA 70 / NFPA 130).
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Profile/Skills Candidate Qualifications & Experience Requirement Details Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Railway Systems Engineering. Experience 10+ years of electrical engineering experience on large-scale transportation or industrial building projects. Software Proficiency Hands-on expertise in ETAP, DigSILENT PowerFactory, AutoCAD, Revit (BIM), and SKM PowerTools.
